name: Makise Haruka
source: The protagonist's fiancée. Her family is looking forward to her coming marriage to Souhei. Secretly however she doesn't want to get married. Ever since they were children Souhei used to tease her. This gave her a masochist fetish. Instead of becoming his bride, she wants to become his pet.
translation: The protagonist's fiancée. Her family is looking forward to her coming marriage to Souhei. Secretly however she doesn't want to get married.
